'''Malagarrian''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the [[Malagarrian|inhabitants]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malagarr/Legends|Malagarr]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The language had both a spoken and a written component.<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" /> 

Around [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]], the people of Malagarr constructed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Q-7N]] included Malagarrian in his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory bank]]. Q-7N eventually went into hibernation on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and his access to the language became unaccessible by the droid until he received a signal from Malagarr. The droid remained in on Yabin 4 until at least the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malagarrian was mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2004]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" />
